overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、货币政策与宏观经济（2 篇）、保险与养老（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、随机过程为主。来源分布：arXiv（8 篇）、Semantic Scholar（3 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Beyond the Counter: Transaction-Based Customer Analytics in a Microfinance Community Pharmacy
papers.venue: International Journal of Recent Advances in Multidisciplinary Topics
papers.abstract: This study develops and applies a structured business intelligence (BI) and data analytics framework to evaluate financial performance, temporal demand patterns, customer purchasing behavior, product category profitability, and inventory classification in a microfinance-linked community pharmacy in the Philippines. A dataset of 186,079 verified point-of-sale records spanning 2023–2025 — refined from 186,399 raw records across 2,511 stock-keeping units and expanded from 23 to 37 variables — was prepared in Microsoft Excel and analyzed through Power BI dashboards using KPI computation, time-series trend analysis, moving-average smoothing, seasonality indexing, day-of-week analysis, t-tests, chi-square tests, and ABC classification. The pharmacy generated ₱22,609,006.07 in gross revenue over three years at a 38.99% gross margin, with 2024 peaking at 13.0% YoY growth and 2025 declining 11.6%. Q1 was the strongest quarter and June a recurring trough. Members averaged a ₱514.10 basket — 3.56 times non-members’ ₱144.61 — with a significant preference for generics (46.75%) versus non-members’ branded preference (52.60%). Generics yielded 64.36% gross margin against 22.15% for branded — a 42.21-point gap. Class A comprised 561 SKUs (22.34%), generating 80.00% of net revenue, led by Losartan 50mg. Analysis is limited to a single branch, restricting generalizability. Findings demonstrate that Excel and Power BI suffice to generate actionable BI for social enterprise pharmacies without clinical, demographic, or enterprise-level data infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究开发并应用了一个结构化的商业智能（BI）和数据分析框架，用于评估菲律宾一家与小额信贷机构合作的社区药房的财务绩效、时间需求模式、顾客购买行为、产品类别盈利能力以及库存分类情况。研究数据集包含186,079条经过验证的销售记录，时间跨度为2023年至2025年，这些数据是从最初的186,399条原始记录中整理而来的，涵盖了2,511个库存单位，并将变量数量从23个增加到了37个。数据集使用Microsoft Excel进行整理，随后通过Power BI仪表板进行了分析，分析方法包括关键绩效指标（KPI）计算、时间序列趋势分析、移动平均平滑处理、季节性指数分析、星期几效应分析、t检验、卡方检验以及ABC分类法。该药房在三年内的总收入为22,609,006.07菲律宾比索，毛利率为38.99%；其中2024年的收入同比增长率达到13.0%，而2025年则下降了11.6%。第一季度是收入最高的季度，而六月则是收入最低的月份。会员的平均消费金额为514.10菲律宾比索，是非会员的3.56倍（非会员的平均消费金额为144.61菲律宾比索）；会员更倾向于购买仿制药（占比46.75%），而...。

papers.title: Equilibrium analysis in a multi-agent reinsurance chain
papers.abstract: This paper investigates a multi-layer reinsurance chain within a stochastic differential game framework involving m competing insurers and n reinsurers. Specifically, Stackelberg differential games are employed to characterize the strategic interactions between reinsurance buyers and sellers at each layer of the chain. In addition, a non-zero-sum game model is established to capture the competitive behavior among insurers. Both insurers and reinsurers are allowed to invest in a risk-free asset and a risky asset. To examine the heterogeneity of reinsurance chains under different contract types, the analysis is conducted separately for proportional reinsurance and excess-of-loss reinsurance. By combining dynamic programming and game theory, closed-form equilibrium strategies for investment and reinsurance are derived by solving the extended Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) systems under the mean-variance (MV) criterion. Numerical analysis is conducted to explore the impact of key parameters on the equilibrium strategies. The results indicate that intensified competition in the insurance market leads to a reduction in the safety loadings of reinsurance contracts at each layer of the reinsurance chain.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在探讨多层再保险链中，保险公司与再保险公司之间的战略互动及竞争行为下的均衡策略。

🔬 研究方法：采用Stackelberg微分博弈和非零和博弈模型，结合动态规划和均值-方差准则，通过求解扩展的HJB系统推导均衡策略。

📊 核心发现：数值分析表明，保险市场激烈的竞争会导致再保险链各层再保险合同的安全费率降低。

💡 应用价值：研究结果为再保险合同定价和投资决策提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Consistent pricing of bivariate interest rate exotics via constrained Schrödinger optimal transport
papers.abstract: We develop a modeling framework for pricing bivariate interest rate exotic derivatives that maintains consistency across three interconnected markets: CMS spread options and the two underlying CMS option markets that define the spread. Our approach also enables the computation of no-arbitrage bounds for exotic derivatives given observable market prices in the spread option and underlying CMS option markets. The method relies on solving the dual Lagrangian of a constrained version of the Shrödinger optimal transport problem and we demonstrate the practical applicability of our framework through concrete numerical examples that illustrate both the pricing methodology and the computation of no-arbitrage bounds. The approach offers a robust tool for pricing complex interest rate derivatives while ensuring consistency with liquid market instruments.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】我们构建了一个用于定价双变量利率奇异衍生品的建模框架，该框架能够确保在三个相互关联的市场中保持一致性：CMS利差期权以及构成该利差的两个基础CMS期权市场。该方法还能够在利差期权和基础CMS期权市场的市场价格可观测的情况下，计算出奇异衍生品的无套利界限。该算法基于求解受限版本的薛定谔最优传输问题的对偶拉格朗日函数，并通过具体的数值示例展示了我们框架的实际应用性，这些示例既说明了定价方法，也展示了无套利界限的计算过程。该方法为定价复杂的利率衍生品提供了一个可靠的工具，同时确保了与流动性市场工具的一致性。。

papers.title: Cryptocurrencies in equity portfolios: trend or opportunity?
papers.abstract: This study develops a large-scale framework to evaluate whether, and under what conditions, adding cryptocurrencies to equity investment universes improves portfolio performance.We apply four long-only portfolio strategies, Global Minimum Variance, Risk Parity, Most Diversified Portfolio, and Equally Weighted, to 10,000 randomly generated investment universes. These universes consist of baskets containing either only equities or varying combinations of equities and cryptocurrencies. We conduct an out-of-sample analysis on real-world data from 2018 to 2023 to assess the influence of cryptocurrencies on portfolio outcomes. The empirical findings reveal that portfolios constructed from mixed equity and cryptocurrency universes provide a better risk-return profile compared to purely equity-based portfolios, particularly for Risk Parity, Most Diversified, and Equally Weighted.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：这项研究旨在评估在何种条件下向股票投资组合中添加加密货币能够改善投资组合的表现。

🔬 研究方法：研究应用了全球最小方差、风险平价等四种长期投资组合策略，对包含股票与加密货币组合的10,000个随机生成投资组合进行了2018年至2023年的样本外分析。

📊 核心发现：实证结果表明，混合股票与加密货币的投资组合比纯股票组合具有更好的风险-收益特征，这一优势在风险平价、最分散化组合和等权组合中尤为明显。

💡 应用价值：该发现表明，投资者在构建股票投资组合时纳入加密货币，可能为改善风险调整后收益提供新的机会。

papers.title: Environmental Sustainability through Environmental Impact Assessment Sustainable Projects in the Asia Pacific Region
papers.venue: Journal of Economics and Public Finance
papers.abstract: The research paper “Environmental Sustainability through Environmental Impact Assessment Sustainable Projects in the Asia Pacific Region” is basically a study of environmental sustainability through environmental impact assessments of environmentally sustainable projects in the Asia Pacific region. The paper dwells into various aspects covering issues such as environmental sustainability, adoption of environmental impact assessment sustainable projects in the Asia Pacific region, role of Asian Development Bank in promoting environmental sustainability in the Asia Pacific region through adoption, promotion and financing of environmentally sustainable projects and projects implemented by the United Nations through its umbrella organization UNEP (United Nations Environment Programme) and EIA which is imperative for achieving environmental sustainability has been instrumental in integration of  environmental considerations into development planning and decision making processes in the region. A detailed literature review has been undertaken by consulting various research papers, publications of authors of international repute, international organizations such as the United Nations, Asian Development Bank, UNEP etc., The study has tried to establish linkages between the EIA and the UN SDGs, identifying issues and their solutions in country related projects in the Asia Pacific region such as the energy transition mechanism in the Philippines, fostering low carbon connectivity and inclusive development, investing in climate-resilient and efficient utilities in Azerbaijan, clean energy potential, climate policy and sustainable finance in Indonesia and Mongolia, integrating specific components of climate resilience and environmental sustainability including investment in hydropower and grid infrastructure projects in Nepal; etc., The study highlights the important  climate related challenges, risks and EIA challenges encountered in the Asia Pacific region. Last, but not the least, the policy conclusions have been drawn highlighting the fact that a robust EIA study would definitely entail in achieving environmentally sustainable projects in the Asia Pacific region which in turn would achieve environmental sustainability in the long-run thereby leading to achieving the UN SDGs by the turn of 2030.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】该学术论文《通过环境影响评估实现亚太地区的环境可持续性》主要探讨了通过环境影响评估来推动亚太地区环境可持续性项目的发展。论文深入分析了多个方面，包括环境可持续性的概念、亚太地区对环境影响评估的采纳情况、亚洲开发银行在促进该地区环境可持续性方面的作用（包括通过资助和推广相关项目），以及联合国及其下属机构联合国环境规划署（UNEP）所实施的项目。环境影响评估在将环境因素纳入该地区的发展规划和决策过程中发挥了关键作用。研究通过查阅大量国际知名学者发表的论文、相关出版物以及联合国、亚洲开发银行、UNEP等国际组织的资料，系统梳理了相关文献。研究试图建立环境影响评估与联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）之间的联系，并分析了亚太地区各国的具体案例，如菲律宾的能源转型机制、阿塞拜疆的低碳发展与包容性增长、印度尼西亚和蒙古的气候适应型高效公用事业建设、尼泊尔的水电及电网基础设施投资等。论文还指出了亚太地区在应对气候相关挑战、实施环境影响评估过程中所面临的问题与困难。最后，研究提出了政策建议，强调完善的环境影响评估体系对于实现亚太地区的环境可持续性至关重要，这将从长远角度推动联合国可持续发展目标的达成。。

papers.title: Existence of $q$-Bass martingales in the semidiscrete setting
papers.abstract: The class of $q$-Bass martingales provides a natural answer to a central question in martingale optimal transport: how to construct martingales with prescribed initial and terminal marginals whose transition kernel remains as close as possible to a given reference measure $q$. We prove the existence of $q$-Bass martingales when the initial marginal is supported on finitely many atoms, and establish uniqueness, up to an additive translation constant, of the associated Bass measure. Our approach is geometric and relies on the analysis of a suitable parametrization of convex polygonal chains.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】$q$-Bass鞅类为鞅最优传输中的一个核心问题提供了自然的解答：如何构造具有预定初始和终止边际的鞅，同时使其转移核尽可能接近给定的参考测度$q$。我们证明了当初始边际仅支持在有限多个点上时$q$-Bass鞅的存在性，并确定了相应Bass测度的唯一性（仅相差一个加性平移常数）。我们的方法基于几何学，并依赖于对凸多边形链的适当参数化的分析。。

papers.title: On the (Non-)Uniqueness of Random Non-Expected Utility
papers.abstract: In random expected utility (Gul and Pesendorfer, 2006), the distribution of preferences is uniquely identified from random choice. This paper investigates whether such identification extends beyond expected utility. We first show that when risk preferences conform to the disappointment aversion model of Gul (1991), the distribution of preferences remains uniquely identified. To assess the scope of this result, we then examine other models of non-expected utility. Within the broader class of betweenness preferences (Dekel, 1986), random utility can be unidentifiable. If preferences are confined to the weighted expected utility class (Chew, 1983), a more nuanced picture emerges: unique identification holds in a three-prize setting but fails with four or more prizes. These findings show that the uniqueness property of random expected utility may persist beyond expected utility, but its persistence critically depends on the class of risk preferences under consideration.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在随机期望效用理论（Gul和Pesendorfer，2006年）中，偏好分布可以通过随机选择行为唯一确定。本文探讨这种唯一性是否也适用于其他效用理论。首先，我们证明了当风险偏好遵循Gul（1991年）提出的失望厌恶模型时，偏好分布仍然能够被唯一确定。为了评估这一结果的应用范围，我们进一步研究了其他非期望效用模型。在更广泛的“中介偏好”理论框架（Dekel，1986年）中，随机效用可能无法被唯一确定。如果偏好仅限于加权期望效用模型（Chew，1983年），则情况有所不同：在三奖项设置中偏好分布仍能被唯一确定，但在四奖项及以上的设置中则无法实现唯一性。这些研究表明，随机期望效用的唯一性特征可能不仅适用于期望效用理论，但其存在性严重依赖于所考虑的风险偏好类型。。

papers.title: Helping People Choose Careers in the Age of AI
papers.abstract: How should people choose careers when artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming the nature of work? We first compare six recent projections of occupational exposure to task automation with AI, examining their methods and assumptions. We then propose a new empirical model of occupational AI exposure based on 2025 query data from Anthropic and OpenAI. We find marked heterogeneity in model predictions, though models published since 2020 show positive relationships among AI exposure, salaries, and occupational complexity. To reduce uncertainty due to heterogeneous assumptions about task automation potential, we average the projections from five models, including our own. Using these averages, we report on likely tradeoffs between salaries and AI exposure across interest categories, O*NET Job Zones, and job fields. Jobs in healthcare practice show the strongest balance of higher pay with lower AI exposure. Among jobs making high use of Anthropic's Claude, those that use it as a complement rather than a substitute for human work are modestly higher-paying, though whether this pattern holds will depend on usage norms adopted in each field.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在人工智能（AI）迅速改变工作性质的情况下，人们应该如何选择职业呢？我们首先对比了六项关于职业因任务自动化而受到AI影响的最新预测研究，分析了这些研究的方法和假设。随后，我们基于Anthropic和OpenAI在2025年的数据，提出了一个新的职业AI影响实证模型。研究发现，不同模型的预测结果存在显著差异；不过自2020年以来发布的模型普遍表明，AI影响与薪资及职业复杂性之间存在正相关关系。为减少因对任务自动化潜力理解不一而产生的不确定性，我们综合了包括我们自己模型在内的五个模型的预测结果。基于这些平均值，我们分析了不同兴趣领域、O*NET职业分类以及各类工作之间薪资与AI影响之间的潜在权衡关系。医疗行业的工作在较高薪资与较低AI影响之间实现了较好的平衡。在大量使用Anthropic的Claude技术的职业中，那些将Claude作为人类工作的补充而非替代工具的职业薪资相对较高，但这种趋势是否成立仍取决于各行业实际采用的使用规范。。

papers.title: All Games Have Equilibria
papers.abstract: Research on Nash equilibrium existence for infinite games has grown into a patchwork of technical preconditions and counterexamples. This paper presents a unified program in equilibrium theory by revising the predominant model of mixed strategies based on countable additivity. A game is specified by a nonempty set of players and, for each player, a nonempty action set and a bounded von Neumann-Morgenstern utility function. Every such game is shown to admit a Nash equilibrium in finitely additive mixed strategies. In addition, the equilibrium correspondence for any such game is shown to be nonempty, compact-valued, and upper hemicontinuous, and the same is true for equilibria obtained as limits of finite approximations. Techniques developed in this paper show that infinite games long treated as intractable become amenable to direct equilibrium analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】关于无限博弈中纳什均衡存在性的研究已经发展成为一个由各种技术性前提条件和反例构成的复杂体系。本文通过修正基于可数可加性的混合策略模型，提出了均衡理论中的一个统一框架。一个博弈由一组非空玩家、每个玩家的非空行动集合以及一个有界的冯·诺伊曼-摩根斯坦效用函数来定义。本文证明了每一个这样的博弈都存在有限可加混合策略下的纳什均衡。此外，还证明了该博弈的均衡对应关系是非空的、取值于紧集的，并且具有上半连续性；同样，通过有限逼近得到的均衡也具有这些性质。本文所开发的技术表明，长期以来被认为难以处理的无限博弈现在也可以直接进行均衡分析。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: AI Trading: Evaluating Large Language Models for Technical Market Analysis
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for processing the heterogeneous information environments of modern financial markets. This paper presents a systematic, comparative evaluation of five prominent LLMs: GPT-4 Turbo, Claude 3 Opus, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3 70B, and the domain-specialized FinGPT, with respect to their capacity for technical market analysis. The evaluation spans four structured tasks: candlestick pattern recognition from OHLCV data, directional signal generation (BUY/SELL/HOLD), backtesting of signal quality through a simulated execution pipeline, and financial report comprehension. Our experimental framework employs rigorous quantitative metrics, including Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, Sortino ratio, information coefficient, F1-score, and BLEU score. Findings from simulated backtesting indicate that GPT-4 Turbo achieves the highest annualized return and Sharpe ratio among general-purpose models, while FinGPT demonstrates competitive risk-adjusted performance due to domain-specific fine-tuning. Both models outperform a passive S&P 500 benchmark under the tested conditions. The study identifies persistent failure modes across all evaluated models, including numerical hallucination, context-window limitations, and inconsistent performance in sideways market regimes. We conclude that while LLMs hold genuine promise within AI trading systems, robust deployment requires careful task decomposition, rigorous backtesting protocols, and domain-aware fine-tuning strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为处理现代金融市场异构信息环境的强大工具。本文对五种主流LLMs（GPT-4 Turbo、Claude 3 Opus、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Llama 3 70B以及专注于金融领域的FinGPT）在技术市场分析能力方面进行了系统的、比较性的评估。评估涵盖了四个结构化任务：从OHLCV数据中识别蜡烛图形态、生成买卖/持有方向信号、通过模拟执行流程对信号质量进行回测，以及理解财务报告。我们的实验框架采用了严格的定量指标，包括夏普比率（Sharpe ratio）、最大回撤率（maximum drawdown）、索蒂诺比率（Sortino ratio）、信息系数（information coefficient）、F1分数（F1-score）和BLEU分数（BLEU score）。模拟回测的结果表明，在通用模型中，GPT-4 Turbo实现了最高的年化回报和夏普比率；而FinGPT由于进行了领域特定的微调，在风险调整后的表现上也具有竞争力。在测试条件下，这两种模型的表现均优于被动的标普500指数基准。研究还发现了所有评估模型中普遍存在的缺陷，包括数值幻觉...。研究方法：大语言模型、实验方法。

papers.title: Stock Market Efficiency During Major Health Crises: International Evidence
papers.abstract: In our research, we analyse the effects of six major global health crises on the stock markets across 38 regions, including both developed and emerging capital markets. We assess stock market efficiency through the lens of price delay. Diverging from the prevailing views in the literature, our findings suggest that pandemic periods are associated with improved stock price efficiency. This aligns with but challenges previous studies by offering new insights into the dynamic responses of financial markets during global health emergencies. Furthermore, we provide evidence consistent with the investor attention channel and the liquidity channel. We also observe that in regions with stronger government capacity, higher internal stability, and lower corruption levels, the improvement in price efficiency is more pronounced after pandemics. Our empirical results remain robust after endogeneity checks, generalized method of moments (GMM) estimation, using alternative measures of price efficiency, and updating data selection criteria. This research uncovers surprising impacts of pandemics on stock markets and provides valuable insights for investors and policymakers alike.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在我们的研究中，我们分析了六大全球健康危机对38个地区（包括发达和新兴资本市场）股市的影响。我们通过价格延迟这一指标来评估股市的效率。与现有文献中的观点不同，我们的研究结果表明，疫情期间股市效率反而有所提高。这一发现与以往的研究结果一致，但同时也对它们提出了挑战，为金融市场在全球健康危机期间的动态反应提供了新的见解。此外，我们的研究结果还支持了“投资者关注效应”和“流动性效应”这两种理论。我们还观察到，在政府能力更强、内部稳定性更高、腐败程度更低的地区，疫情过后股市效率的提升更为显著。经过内生性检验、广义矩估计（GMM）方法的应用、采用不同的价格效率衡量标准以及更新数据选择标准后，我们的实证结果依然稳健。这项研究揭示了疫情对股市的意外影响，为投资者和政策制定者提供了宝贵的参考信息。。研究方法：广义矩估计。

papers.title: Algorithmic Intermediation and the International Transmission of U.S. Monetary Policy
papers.abstract: This paper examines how algorithmic and AI-driven fund management shapes the international transmission of U.S. monetary policy to emerging markets. It argues that the key source of instability is not algorithmic intermediation itself, but the similarity of models across funds. When algorithms rely on similar signals and make correlated errors, their trades reinforce one another and intensify capital-flow responses during periods of stress. When models are diverse, errors offset each other and algorithmic investors can stabilize flows. The paper develops a two-region macro-financial framework and tests its central prediction using equity portfolio flows to nineteen emerging markets from 2000 to 2024. The evidence shows that algorithmic herding amplifies outflows after U.S. monetary shocks only in high-volatility regimes, while faster adjustment alone has no comparable effect. The results imply that policy should focus on preserving model diversity rather than limiting the size of non-bank intermediation.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】本文探讨了算法和人工智能驱动的基金管理机制如何影响美国货币政策向新兴市场的国际传导。研究认为，导致市场不稳定的关键因素并非算法中介本身，而是不同基金所采用的模型之间的相似性。当算法依赖相似的信号并产生相关的错误时，这些交易会相互强化，在市场压力期间加剧资本流动的波动。相反，如果模型具有多样性，错误效应可以相互抵消，从而有助于算法投资者稳定资本流动。本文构建了一个双区域宏观金融框架，并利用2000年至2024年间19个新兴市场的股票投资组合数据验证了这一框架的核心预测。研究结果表明，只有在高波动性环境下，算法的从众行为才会加剧美国货币政策冲击后的资本外流；而单纯的快速调整机制则无法产生类似的效果。研究结论提示，政策应着重于维护模型多样性，而非限制非银行中介机构的规模。。
